title: How Beauty Brands Should Prepare a Custom Cosmetic Packaging RFQ
buyer_question: How should a beauty brand prepare a custom cosmetic packaging RFQ?
short_answer: A beauty brand should prepare product dimensions, jar or bottle weight, retail channel, insert requirement, finish direction, artwork status, target market and launch timing before asking for a cosmetic packaging quote. A supplier can review structure and material options more accurately when the box fit, product protection and brand presentation requirements are clear first.
comparison_rows: Jar/serum/set fit checklist with insert notes
MUGE page should show RFQ-ready size and insert fields
Finish explained by brand expression and retail channel
Use finish comparison blocks, not only a gallery
Ask target market and review documents before confirmation
competitor_signals: Packoi and PakFactory show direct custom packaging/quote signals; WestRock and International Paper show stronger solution-style education.
